title: Thifrus' Create Forever Series
description: The official modpack used in Thifrus' Create Forever World series.
body:
The Create Forever World Series is a modpack made by Thifrus mainly starring the Create mod along with many fun mods like Automobility, Immersive Aircraft, Ships, Paintings, many decoration mods and great building tools. Every mod not at all carefully selected nor hand picked. Feel free to add any fun mod you see fit for your playthrough!

![Form your factory with the Creat Mod & addons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82eeccbe360493f824015d6a7102e66c82eba084_0.webp)
